children.game_version: Partner walking game moving in a circle to 3/4 music, switching partners on phrase changes.

seniors.counts: 3/4 time slow walk on counts one and three.
seniors.seated_version: Seated upper-body rotation simulating bakmes and pols turns with arm movements.
seniors.standing_version: Supported solo walking step marking beats one and three without rapid rotation.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo with eliminated turns and restricted range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: close hold escort position underarm turns
movement_profile.footwork: Walking promenade steps, stepping primarily on the first and third beat during resting phases
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couples traveling counter-clockwise around the periphery of the floor or stationary on a spot
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Rotating counter-clockwise in bakmes and clockwise in pols rotations
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Grounded footwork with rapid rotation; no major aerial jumps documented
movement_profile.partnering: Partner dance led by the male through a sequence of holds, turns, and promenades
movement_profile.posture: Upper body facing as a couple, maintaining a close embrace or escort position

signature_moves.description: Counter-clockwise couple rotation at a rate of one revolution per two measures
signature_moves.name: Bakmes turn

signature_moves.description: Clockwise couple rotation at a rate of one full turn per measure
signature_moves.name: Pols turn

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Fast, driving triple meter with organic pulse shifts

music_profile.musical_form: Two or three eight-bar phrases, each repeated (32 to 64 measures per tune cycle)
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Semiquaver, quaver, or triplet groupings with lengthened second beats in specific regional styles
music_profile.sound_description: Fiddles drive the melody through repeating motifs, drone strings on the Hardanger fiddle, and uneven beats where musicians traditionally tap only the first and third beats.

basic_steps: Resting step on beats one and three
teaching.formation: Partner dance moving counter-clockwise around the room or on a fixed spot
teaching.level_notes: Requires strong core stability, balance, and coordination for rapid rotational steps.
teaching.rhythm: Triple time (3/4) with variable beat weights and asymmetrical phrasing
